detaileddescription.para: Looks for inputPrefix prefixed options. Push the stripped-off option in the result list. Warning: As opposed to what the former documentation was saying this function doesn't modify argList.

Looks for inputPrefix-prefixed options. Push the stripped-off option in the result list. If isOptionTakingSecondParameter of the inputPrefix-prefixed returns true, add the parameter(s) to the result list.
